terminal_user_goal: Make the user's existing GameLoop PUBG Mobile installation actually render and run instead of presenting the persistent black screen, while preserving user data and avoiding speculative destructive changes.
selection_basis: Live canonical state names END_TO_END_COMPUTER_WORK as the highest-leverage gap. This unresolved real user problem forces research, Windows inspection, emulator control, evidence recovery, diagnosis, reversible action, and effect verification.

prior_work_search.consequence: Do not repeat ABI/translator toggles already represented by preserved backups and receipts.

verified_findings: GameLoop starts com.tencent.ig and reports OnAppRunning bRun=1; the black screen is not a simple failure to launch the package.
Host NVIDIA RTX 4060 and OpenGL 4.6 are detected and a render policy is selected.
A reversible ForceDirectX 0->1 probe did not repair the black main render area and was rolled back to 0.
AEngine100.log repeatedly records crash_type=4002 for com.tencent.ig with exception 0xc0000005 in /system/lib64/libc.so and stack frames in /system/lib64/libhotx612.so.

Preserved guest logcat records Fatal signal 11 SIGSEGV and repeated com.tencent.ig process death/restart while GameLoop initializes libhotx612.so Houdini 6.1.2d and loads ARM64 libanogs.so and libanort.so through NativeBridge.

The locally installed APK source is GL_4.6_FIXCRASH.apk, not a clean official package. Its lib/arm64-v8a/libalo.so is a 102-byte JSON marker naming profile NTHMOD and URL http://android.keyauth.click/uplib.php.
The official PUBG MOBILE site currently exposes PUBGMOBILE_Global_4.6.0_uawebsite_livik01_5678FCFA.apk (Content-Length 1274351207, Last-Modified 2026-08-26, byte ranges supported).

Without downloading the 1.27 GB APK, its ZIP central directory was read by HTTP range and compared with the local APK. Critical native libraries differ: official libanogs.so CRC a99b4e2e vs local eb7f6ea4; official libanort.so 7d3562a3 vs local 56408602; official libUE4.so 0b2fa301 vs local cfc972ca; official libkk-image.so d77c2a35 vs local 0c1ad151.

The local APK also contains non-official/additional native entries including libAkAudioVisiual.so, libalo.so and libpandora-core.so, while the official APK contains multiple libraries absent from the local package.

Official libanogs.so and libanort.so were extracted losslessly via HTTP byte ranges only, with CRC verification, into C:\Temp\TxGameDownload\MobileGamePCShared\official_probe; no full APK download was required.
exact_current_causal_frontier: The strongest evidence-backed hypothesis is now that the black screen is downstream of the modified PUBG 4.6 native payload interacting with GameLoop's ARM64-to-x86_64 NativeBridge/Houdini path. The first loaded native libraries libanogs.so and libanort.so are byte-different from the official 4.6 APK, and the repeated crash occurs in the translation/runtime path. Causality is not yet proven until a surgical official-library substitution is replayed.

prepared_repair_probe.probe_behavior: Back up the installed guest libanogs/libanort to shared storage, replace only those two with official 4.6 bytes, relaunch once, and compare crash/render behavior.
prepared_repair_probe.not_executed_reason: The normal GameLoop command injection path is cached by the already-running emulator. During preparation, cmd.conf also changed independently (a pre-existing rootcause_once route appeared), proving concurrent troubleshooting activity. The temporary command injection was removed and cmd.conf restored exactly rather than forcing a restart that could interfere with another active controller.

next_action: At the next safe exclusive-control window, execute the already-prepared two-library official substitution probe exactly once, preserve before/after hashes and crash/render evidence, then either keep the repair if the black screen clears or restore the backed-up libraries immediately and move only to the next divergent library causally implicated by the new trace.
